text:
maya: FYI planning a kernel rebase + quant build push tonight in the 02:00 UTC change window. ABI bump included. Need pin strategy and a clear rollback trigger set. I'll draft a short ops runbook here.
sam_t: +1. Do we have the compatibility matrix for older binaries? want to avoid long tail failures on Dedicated.
jia: I'm running the quant build now against the canary image. Found a perf regression on seq_len 1024 (~6% p95 increase). pushing logs to the canary bucket.
maya: thanks Jia — please paste the log snippet if it's obvious. we need to decide whether to hold canary or proceed with staged traffic.
jia: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-19T23:45:12Z] kernel_v2: matmul_kernel: tile fallback triggered for block_dim=16
[2026-03-19T23:45:12Z] perf: p95 +6.2% (baseline 48ms -> 51ms)
```
oliver: If p95 reg is limited to a specific kernel path we can enable the legacy matmul for affected devices only. That would be a temporary pin per-hardware.
maya: good idea. For rollback criteria proposal:
- abort if canary error rate > 0.5% for 10m OR p95 latency increase > 5% sustained for 15m
- automatic pin to legacy kernel for affected GPU families if identified
- manual rollback to previous runtime if cross-region anomalies appear
sam_t: can we make the pin automatic via deploybot? e.g. deploybot:pin kernel=legacy on hostgroup=nv100 when anomaly detected
deploy-bot: scheduled: kernel_rebase_v2 will start 2071237200 (02:00:00 UTC). Staged canary 5% for 10m -> 30% for 20m -> 100% if no alarms. Hooks: smoke, perf-check, region-consistency.
jia: left a small smoke test list in the doc link: https://rwd.internal/runbooks/kernel-rebase-2071 (will update with exact commands)
oliver: For Dedicated customers: we should publish a short compatibility note and a secret toggle to opt out of abi bump for one week. ops can flip it if customers report issues.
maya: agreed. Open action items:
- Jia: finalize perf logs + perf-check thresholds (ETA 00:45 UTC)
- Sam: add deploybot pin/auto-action config + rollback playbook (ETA 01:30 UTC)
- Oliver: docs + customer opt-out toggle (ETA 01:00 UTC)
- Maya: release notes draft + announce in #all-hands at deploy time
sam_t: I'll also add a link to the canary dashboard and a Grafana alert rule snippet: `expr = increase(errors_total[10m]) / increase(requests_total[10m]) > 0.005`
maya: if anyone hits blockers DM me. otherwise we'll proceed with the staged rollout and the automatic kernel pin fallback configured. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: update: preflight checks passed (smoke=ok, build-signatures=ok). Canary will be applied to subset 'night-bucket-a' at 02:00 UTC.
